description: The dataset title identifies experimental material supporting a poster about multi-walled carbon nanotubes encapsulated in polyether-sulfone beads for removing disinfection byproducts from water. This is a specified water-treatment material study, not a general carbon-nanotube collection. The related poster is separately available, but its availability does not release the restricted source data or establish measured removal performance. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The source marks the data restricted while publishing CC BY 4.0 metadata. No access procedure, fee, availability date or permission to obtain the underlying files is established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
